Activity Feed

Activity feeds surface a chronological stream of user and system events. Combine avatars, icons, images, status indicators, and grouped sections.

Basic Activity Feed

Use .zak-activity-feed with .zak-activity-item rows.

  • Janet Fox created invoice #1024 12 minutes ago
  • Mark Kim pushed 3 commits to main 48 minutes ago
  • Sara Reyes commented on #304 2 hours ago
HTML
<ul class="zak-activity-feed">
  <li class="zak-activity-item">
    <div class="zak-activity-content">
      <span class="zak-activity-text">
        <strong>Janet Fox</strong> created invoice #1024
      </span>
      <span class="zak-activity-time">12 minutes ago</span>
    </div>
  </li>
</ul>

With Avatars

Prefix each item with the actor's avatar.

  • JA
    Janet Fox uploaded a new design Today, 09:32
  • MK
    Mark Kim deployed v2.4.0 to production Yesterday, 17:05
  • SR
    Sara Reyes invited 3 team members Yesterday, 14:11
HTML
<li class="zak-activity-item">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-2xl zak-avatar-primary">JA</span>
  <div class="zak-activity-content">
    <span class="zak-activity-text"><strong>Janet Fox</strong> uploaded a new design</span>
    <span class="zak-activity-time">Today, 09:32</span>
  </div>
</li>

With Images

Include inline preview images for media activity.

  • Janet Fox added a photo to Launch assets Today, 10:20
HTML
<div class="zak-activity-content">
  <span class="zak-activity-text"><strong>Janet Fox</strong> added a photo</span>
  <span class="zak-activity-time">Today, 10:20</span>
  <img src="preview.png" alt="Launch asset preview"
       style="width: 5rem; height: 4rem; border-radius: var(--zak-radius-sm);">
</div>

With Actions

Append actions like brief buttons or menus to an item.

  • Noah Carter requested access to #billing 5 minutes ago
  • Emma Foster mentioned you in Design review 1 hour ago View thread
HTML
<div class="zak-activity-content">
  <span class="zak-activity-text"><strong>Noah Carter</strong> requested access</span>
  <span class="zak-activity-time">5 minutes ago</span>
  <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-sm">Approve</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline zak-btn-sm">Decline</button>
  </div>
</div>

Status Indicators

Pair an icon or dot marker with the event to convey state.

  • Deployment #182 completed Today, 08:00
  • Certificate expires in 7 days for api.example.com 2 hours ago
  • 5 failed logins for Mark Kim 3 hours ago
HTML
<li class="zak-activity-item">
  <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-success zak-badge-dot"></span>
  <div class="zak-activity-content">
    <span class="zak-activity-text">Deployment #182 completed</span>
    <span class="zak-activity-time">Today, 08:00</span>
  </div>
</li>

Grouped by Day

Split the feed with header rows for time ranges.

Today

  • Janet Fox created Q3 roadmap 08:42
  • Mark Kim merged feat/dark-table 10:15

Yesterday

  • Sara Reyes exported the analytics report 16:20
  • System rotated API keys for prod 02:00
HTML
<h4>Today</h4>
<ul class="zak-activity-feed">
  <li class="zak-activity-item">...</li>
</ul>

<h4>Yesterday</h4>
<ul class="zak-activity-feed">
  <li class="zak-activity-item">...</li>
</ul>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-activity-feedRoot list with connecting track
.zak-activity-itemSingle feed row (flex with avatar/marker slot)
.zak-activity-contentText + time + optional extras
.zak-activity-textMain event description
.zak-activity-timeMuted timestamp
.zak-activity-thumbPreview image block (optional)

Accessibility

  • Wrap items in a <ul> to preserve order for assistive tech.
  • Provide a text timestamp (<time> with datetime where possible) rather than only relative text.
  • Status dots need an aria-label or accompanying text so meaning isn't color-only.
  • Avatar/icon markers should be presentational (aria-hidden) when the text already identifies the actor.
  • Inline actions must stay reachable by keyboard and separated from feed text.
